# Product · N usage demos

**Ship rule:** every Product · N PR needs a **usage** GIF in the PR body under `## How it looks` — capture of the **real Nanoodle editor** (`index.html`) using the feature (nodes / wires / soft tips / Examples), not the old fake mini-editor HTML loops and not metrics scorecards.

| Product | Real editor | GIF |
| --- | --- | --- |
| · 1 | `index.html?product=1` — learned soft tips | `product-1.gif` |
| · 2 | `index.html?product=2` — action log + schema tokens | `product-2.gif` |
| · 3 | `index.html?product=3` — frequency soft tips / ghosts | `product-3.gif` |
| · 4 | `index.html?product=4` — Examples shelf → gallery bake corpus | `product-4.gif` |
| · 5 | `index.html?product=5` — local action ring filling as you edit | `product-5.gif` |
| · 6 | `index.html?product=6` — cold-start seeds + first-trio chips | `product-6.gif` |
| · 9 | `index.html?product=9` — anti-slop soft mask on Text→LLM tips | `product-9.gif` |

Serve locally: `python3 -m http.server` from repo root, then open `/index.html?product=N`.

Legacy `product-N.html` mini-editors are deprecated (Mikkel: not the Nanoodle product).
